title: EXP-07 Authoritative Training Failure and Recovery Policy
failure_lifecycle: 1. DETECT: Continuous per-step and per-epoch automated assertions.
2. CAPTURE: Dump current optimizer step, epoch, batch tensors summary, and traceback to disk.
3. STOP: Terminate execution cleanly without mutating previously saved best checkpoints.
4. PRESERVE: Retain run directory, logs, and failure telemetry under run_state.failed.json.
5. CLASSIFY: Categorize root cause (NUMERICAL, DATA_IO, RESOURCE, IMPLEMENTATION).
6. INCIDENT: Log in incident learning register if root cause is a genuine defect.
7. NO_SILENT_RETRY: Prohibit automatic retry with modified hyperparameters without an authorized revision.

failure_modes.name: NaN or Inf Loss
failure_modes.action: Immediate halt. Save step telemetry, model weights at failure step, and current batch index. Mark status NUMERICAL_DIVERGENCE.

failure_modes.name: Exploding Gradient Norm
failure_modes.action: Warning logged; gradient clipped to max_norm=1.0. If grad_norm > 1000.0 for 3 consecutive steps, halt training.

failure_modes.name: Trivial All-Background Collapse
failure_modes.trigger: Unique predicted classes across entire DEV evaluation contains only class 0 (BG) after epoch 10.
failure_modes.action: Flag as DEGENERATE_COLLAPSE. Halt early stopping counter, record failure in telemetry.

failure_modes.name: Out of Memory (OOM)
failure_modes.action: Clean up CUDA cache, log allocated memory vs peak memory, terminate with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION.

failure_modes.name: DataLoader / Rasterio File Read Failure
failure_modes.action: Log missing or corrupt file path and sample ID; halt immediately with DATA_IO_FAILURE.

failure_modes.name: BatchNorm Statistics Instability
failure_modes.action: Halt immediately with BATCHNORM_INSTABILITY. Record failing layer name and batch statistics.

failure_modes.name: Corrupted Target Label
failure_modes.action: Halt immediately with INVALID_LABEL_INDEX. Record offending sample ID.

failure_modes.name: Checkpoint Write Failure
failure_modes.trigger: OSError or IOError during checkpoint save
failure_modes.action: Retry write to temporary file once. If failed, halt and alert DISK_IO_FAILURE without deleting previous checkpoint.

failure_modes.name: DEV Metric Undefined / NaN
failure_modes.action: Reject checkpoint update. If persisting for 3 consecutive epochs, halt with METRIC_CALCULATION_ERROR.

failure_modes.name: Uncontrolled Metric Divergence
failure_modes.action: Log warning. If dev_loss exceeds 20.0, halt with OPTIMIZATION_DIVERGENCE.
